func columnsWithAliases(f queryfields.Set, mapping map[string]string) []string {
	names := f.Names()
	cols := make([]string, 0, len(names))
	for _, name := range names {
		if expr, ok := mapping[name]; ok {
			cols = append(cols, expr+" AS "+name)
		}
	}
	return cols
}

func selectColumns(f queryfields.Set, mapping map[string]string) string {
	return strings.Join(columnsWithAliases(f, mapping), ", ")
}
